skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Create polished frontend interfaces with strong visual direction and production-ready implementation guidance.
skill.author: 1bertogit

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces reduce trust and make products feel unfinished. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create polished frontend designs with clear visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides the assistant to choose a clear visual direction before coding.
Encourages production-ready HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue implementation.
Improves typography, color, motion, composition, and visual details.
Promotes context-aware layouts for pages, components, applications, and interface panels.
Discourages common AI design patterns, generic fonts, and predictable visual themes.
limitations: It provides design and implementation guidance, not a complete design system by itself.
It does not guarantee accessibility unless accessibility requirements are included.
It does not include asset generation or image licensing support.
It may need project-specific constraints for exact framework, browser, and performance targets.

use_cases.title: Create a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Design and build a polished dashboard with a distinct visual style, strong hierarchy, and useful interaction states.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Turn a plain landing page into a more memorable experience with stronger typography, motion, and layout choices.

use_cases.title: Prototype an App Interface
use_cases.description: Generate a working interface concept that matches the product audience, tone, and technical constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Simple Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one reusable interface element.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pricing card component for a small SaaS product. Use a distinctive visual style and production-ready CSS.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a complete page with clear visual direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a landing page for an AI security startup. Choose a bold aesthetic direction and implement the full responsive page.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Interface
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for redesigning a current screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Redesign this settings panel for a developer tool. Keep the same features, but improve hierarchy, spacing, motion, and visual polish.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Screen Prototype
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for product-level interface design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-screen prototype for a music collaboration app. Define a cohesive visual system and implement realistic interactive states.

output_examples.input: Create a dashboard for a music streaming app.
output_examples.output: A responsive dashboard with a clear visual concept, refined typography, animated state changes, and production-ready component structure.

output_examples.input: Build a landing page for an AI security startup.
output_examples.output: A complete page with a strong brand tone, distinctive color system, polished layout, and responsive sections for product messaging.

output_examples.input: Design a settings panel with dark mode.
output_examples.output: A functional settings interface with careful spacing, accessible contrast targets, clear controls, and a coherent dark theme.

best_practices: Provide the product context, target users, and desired tone before asking for implementation.
Specify the framework, component boundaries, and responsive targets needed for your project.
Ask for accessibility, performance, and interaction requirements when they matter.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic modern design without product context.
Do not request visual polish while omitting required content, states, or data density.
Do not rely on the skill to replace design review, usability testing, or accessibility validation.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create web components, pages, and application interfaces with stronger visual direction and production-quality implementation guidance.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks the assistant to implement working frontend code, not only describe design ideas.

faq.question: Does it choose a design style automatically?
faq.answer: It encourages the assistant to choose a clear aesthetic direction based on the request and product context.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing interface?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the current interface, constraints, and goals so the assistant can preserve function while improving design quality.

faq.question: Is it a security or deployment tool?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on frontend design guidance and implementation quality, not security scanning or deployment automation.
